plugins.name: grill-skills
plugins.description: Refinement-to-PR grills: grill-feature (goal, scope and user stories with acceptance criteria for the stakeholder ask, before architecture), then architectural and implementation pressure-testing split by altitude: grill-architecture (macro, ADR-worthy decisions, before code) and grill-implementation (per-slice mechanics, fix-now list, at code-time); then implement (builds the slice, commits, and runs review on it) and review (per-axis findings with a fix-now/allow call on each).
